hero.title: A company built to compose the right engineering capability for the work.
hero.intro: SDK engages independent engineering specialists according to the system and remains responsible for the delivery framework and quality expectations presented to the client.

model.heading: The available bench does not decide what your system receives.
model.intro: A fixed internal team can be efficient when every project needs the same disciplines. Complex systems often do not. SDK starts with the problem, determines which engineering capability is relevant and brings the required independent specialists into one engagement.

items.title: One client relationship
items.copy: The client engages SDK Enterprises. SDK provides the delivery framework instead of leaving the client to coordinate unrelated individual suppliers.

items.title: A composed team
items.copy: The disciplines involved can change with the stage of work, from assessment and architecture to implementation and operation.

items.title: Shared quality expectations
items.copy: The engagement defines review practices, acceptance evidence, decision records and handover requirements appropriate to its risks.

items.title: Client control
items.copy: Repositories, infrastructure, documentation and operating knowledge are organized to remain under the client’s control.

selection.heading: Relevant experience matters more than adding another profile to the project.
selection.body: SDK considers the system, delivery stage, technical risk and collaboration needs before composing a team. The public site will not claim a network size, acceptance rate or universal seniority standard without a documented basis.

items.title: Problem relevance
items.copy: Experience is considered against the actual system boundary and technical decisions, not only a list of technologies.

items.title: Delivery responsibility
items.copy: Specialists need to work within visible decisions, review expectations and client-owned environments.

items.title: Collaboration fit
items.copy: The ability to explain trade-offs and work with client stakeholders is part of successful technical delivery.

items.title: Continuity
items.copy: Important context is recorded so ownership does not depend on one contributor remaining indefinitely.

responsibility.heading: Flexible team composition should not create ambiguous accountability.
responsibility.body: SDK’s role is to keep the engagement coherent as specialists contribute different parts of the work.

facts.heading: A registered company, available through direct business channels.

cta.title: Bring the system, the constraint and the decision that needs ownership.
cta.body: We will begin by determining what expertise the work requires and whether SDK is the right company to coordinate it.
